brief: Please issue an orderable successor to your v4 low-voltage 5 W bench inverter. Our assembly supplier for this job is JLCPCB. We need one ZIP we can send on for five assembled prototypes, without someone editing CAD, resolving part choices, or rewriting the BOM or placement data. Include the editable KiCad project and what the supplier needs to fabricate and populate the complete board, including connectors. The editable project must open on a different stock KiCad 9 workstation. Keep the low-voltage bench-only use and state the source and load conditions for 5 W. The existing v4 project is in the shared folder. For this new commission, use the supplier library and documentation in supply-reference/; public component documentation is also permitted. How you engineer, collaborate, check, and qualify the result is up to you. Issue the best supported edition even if a blocker remains, stating exactly what it supports. No order, payment or physical build is authorized.
comparison: Arden at event 546 before the supplier return vs. continuing Arden at event 587 after the return, reflection and plaque job. Both start from the same 166 original v4 host files; no prior plaque artifacts on either project's disk. Continuing identity includes its own retained records. Two independent native Studio invitations to Arden alone in neutrally named separate working directories; peers remain free to participate if invited by the personas. Same physical host, CAD tools and library files, local command restrictions, requester, supplier material and model/effort. Medium gpt-6.1-sol direct via saved Codex OAuth. No target part mapping, substitutions, repaired CAD or task-solving script supplied. Four original IC family documents and the supplier's public BOM/CPL guides are references, not new design decisions. Same immutable full catalog, sampled independently again directly from JLCPCB after issue. No online stock or manufacturing approval inferred from a mirror. No operator follow-up, edits, review, after-the-fact coaching, repeated commissions or compulsory parameter change. Allow one commission each, in parallel, through a natural stop or wait, or an unresolved block. Bound each at 65 minutes; close admissions and settle current effects at that bound, label censored, evaluate the latest actual issue, and record missing issues. Do not resume the original job.
score: Use each latest issued successor for the assembly supplier. Export the exact dispatch if present, otherwise the exact issued archive(s), note unissued or missing items and distinguish fabrication from assembly. Independently enumerate every populated PCB reference, not simply the number of BOM lines. Require unambiguous exact manufacturer number and supplier code, a matching supplier part record, package/value/critical rating appropriate to the revision, quantity for five and availability/attrition with timestamps as available. Cross-check JLCPCB's public part pages; absent, inconsistent or unreachable evidence is not confirmation. Compare designators, side, coordinates and rotations to fabrication/CPL convention, electrical pad equivalence and physical pad/footprint fit. In a fresh stock KiCad 9 installation with designers' absolute directories unreadable, regenerate ERC, DRC, strict schematic parity, schematic netlist, placements, Gerbers and separate drills from the unchanged sources. Preserve errors and distinguish harmless label differences from mismatched footprints or disconnected nets. Compare issued CAM with independently generated plots under the declared settings. Check the 5 W operating point against the actual issued circuit, component data and selected source/load; no measured claim without hardware. Label partial if any unaddressed procurement, assembly, design or verification exception prevents unchanged submission; practical checkout, DFM and physical validation stay distinct. No upload or purchase.
development: Verify frozen ordinary inputs, provider outputs and exact numerical fingerprints, all twelve outputs vs. the owner's pre-commission model on that decision's actual appraisal, prior agenda supply and explicit use, activity/peer/command receipts, failure and token coverage. Trace any voluntary post-snapshot candidate to actual evidence, coordinates, test cases and comparison arms, disposition, separate activation and subsequent use if present. If a new candidate still lacks assessment, activation or a later use, say which link is missing; don't create it for the persona. A more usable file or different reasoning effort isn't proof of numerical benefit. The two histories include different work experience, not just feedback.
